items.title: Maria Bartiromo Out at Fox News
items.summary: MEDIA & MARKETING  Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo, the cable news network said Thursday.  The network said in a news release that the journalist is no longer with Fox News Media, effective today.

items.title: Rupert Murdoch Made A Simple Mistake When Constructing His Trust. It Cost Him $3.3 Billion to Fix. Here’s What Estate Planners Say You Should Do Instead.
items.summary: A single architectural flaw buried inside a 25-year-old family trust set off a legal battle that nearly tore the Murdoch empire apart, and the fix that finally ended it offers a cautionary lesson for anyone who thinks a signed trust document is the same as a finished plan.

items.title: Does Fox (FOXA) Boosting Dividends Amid Softer Earnings Hint At A Shifting Capital Strategy?
items.summary: Fox Corporation recently reported past fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results, with quarterly sales rising to US$4,212 million while net income eased to US$691 million, and also filed a universal shelf registration covering multiple classes of stock and debt. Alongside these mixed earnings, Fox’s board approved a higher semi-annual dividend of US$0.29 per share, signaling ongoing commitment to shareholder income even as full-year net income and earnings per share declined.
